references.role: backdrop, light, framing and turn (published Plump material card)

steps.prompt: Create one square studio product photograph of a single object. Image 1 is the STYLE, CAMERA, LIGHT AND ANGLE REFERENCE. Match it exactly: the same seamless pale cool blue-gray paper backdrop and floor with the same soft gradient that is slightly brighter on the right, the same soft diffused key light from the upper right, the same soft contact shadow falling toward the LEFT on the floor, the same gentle highlights, the same camera height slightly above the object's center and the same moderate lens perspective. The object rests on the floor in the center of the frame and its width fills about 65 percent of the frame width, the same visual size as the object in Image 1. The viewing angle and lighting must come from Image 1, not from Image 2. Rotate the object about 30 degrees around its vertical axis so that its LEFT side wall turns partly toward the camera and is clearly visible as a band of thickness along its left edge, while its right side wall stays hidden, exactly like the object in Image 1. Do not copy the shape, color or chrome material of the object in Image 1. The product to photograph is Link, a solid object made of vermilion red soft-touch matte silicone, color close to #D32823, with a smooth, very slightly satiny surface and thick, softly rounded pillow-like edges. Image 2 is its flat geometric silhouette: two rounded loops fused diagonally by one broad bridge, each loop with exactly one rounded hole, two holes in total. Keep that contour, exactly two holes, the diagonal orientation from lower left to upper right and the proportions. The object is about as thick as the object in Image 1 and rests upright on the floor on its lower loop. Because of the turn, the outline looks slightly narrower than the silhouette, the thickness of its left side is visible, and the inner walls of both holes show their depth. Show only this one object. No text, writing, signature, maker's mark, stamp, logo, label, prop, person, pedestal, plinth or second object.

selection.note: Nine candidates. c1-c6 used the previous card as a material reference and kept its frontal view and left-side light. c7-c9 used only Plump's card and the silhouette, with the color sampled from the previous card (#D32823): c7 merged Plump's four lobes and showed four holes, c8 turned too far and drifted from the backdrop, and c9 keeps two holes, turns left and casts its shadow left like Plump.

steps.prompt:
Create a single original photorealistic fashion-editorial photograph, with NO TEXT anywhere. Image 1 is the exact geometric object and its material: preserve its silhouette, openings, color and surface. Image 2 is a visual direction reference for contemporary Japanese and Korean fashion-editorial styling, beautiful adult female casting, natural fresh makeup, airy black hair, restrained white/gray/black clothing, candid direct-flash photography and an ordinary setting with one strange oversized object. Do not reproduce the reference model's identity, outfit or exact pose. Cast a distinct original East Asian woman age 25, with an appealing expressive face, real skin and believable hands. Calm natural gaze, youthful energy and relaxed styling. Clear gentle features, not severe high-fashion contour makeup. The object is part of a physical scene, not a product being presented in a catalog. Keep the person and object in the LEFT 58 percent, and keep the RIGHT 36 percent quiet pale wall for live website text. Keep the very top edge pale and uncluttered for navigation. No typography, words, letters, numbers, watermarks, brand names, UI, borders, signage or captions. No other people. No school uniforms or sexualized styling.

A beautiful adult woman with long sleek black hair and a delicate straight fringe, expressive clear eyes, soft natural rose lips and minimal fresh makeup. She wears an opaque white relaxed long-sleeved poplin blouse with an open collar, a fitted charcoal waistcoat and wide gray tailored trousers, a tiny silver stud earring. She sits on the edge of a polished tubular steel bench in front of a clean pale tiled urban wall. She leans forward slightly with a cool, curious direct gaze, her head subtly tilted. ONE oversized vermilion silicone double-loop shape rests diagonally across her lap, held naturally at its outer edge by one hand; her other hand rests on the bench. Exact object from Image 1: TWO holes, two padded round lobes connected by one broad bridge, no separate chain pieces. The saturated red has a tactile satin finish. Soft black-and-white styling and precise natural beauty, contemporary Seoul/Tokyo fashion editorial, relaxed rather than a stiff sales pose. Direct flash with a crisp mild shadow, neutral daylight, subtle grain, realistic fabric and skin. Slightly elevated 35mm camera, medium shot from thighs up, complete head and entire red shape. Person and prop in left 58 percent; right 36 percent blank pale tiled wall. No words, lettering or typography anywhere.

Edit the supplied original AI fashion photograph into a matching 9:16 mobile photograph. Image 1 is the selected source image: preserve the SAME adult woman's exact face, hairstyle, outfit, posture, object, material, lighting and scene. Image 2 is the precise object/material reference. Make an original vertical composition from the same shoot, never a collage. Photorealistic natural skin and believable hands. No text, typography, numbers, logos, watermark, interface, border or decorative graphics.

Use case: identity-preserve. Recompose as a vertical environmental fashion photograph from the same shoot. Preserve the woman with long black hair and light fringe, white long-sleeved blouse, charcoal waistcoat and gray trousers, sitting on the metal and wood bench. Keep the single red silicone double-loop with TWO open holes and ONE broad connecting bridge across her lap. Both holes must remain visible. Preserve her exact face, delicate makeup and crisp direct-flash lighting. Critical mobile layout: pull camera back so the entire head begins 30 percent down from the top, with no person or prop in the upper 27 percent. This top 27 percent is continuous pale wall for live website title. Head and face around the upper-middle, between 32 and 44 percent of height. Person and the entire object occupy the central 76 percent of width and the middle 32 to 76 percent of height, leaving room for narrow crops. Lower 20 percent contains low-detail pale floor or the pale base of the bench so a button can overlay it. The woman has a natural fully coherent seated body and legs, no distorted limbs. Keep the face, hair, clothing, light and object identical to Image 1. Plain photograph, do not add any text or create a separate blank panel.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, an original AI photograph. Perform only the specified background repair. Preserve the adult woman's exact identity, face, hair, clothing, anatomy, skin texture, object geometry, material, light and all existing positions. Preserve the original camera, framing and photographic realism. Output one seamless full-bleed photograph with no text, typography, watermark, interface, borders, blank graphic panels or collage joins.

Remove the foreground rectangular marble slab covering the bottom 14 percent. Show the continuous real light-gray concrete floor beneath the same bench instead, with appropriate soft shadows and lower bench supports. Keep the visible person, face, hair, clothing, red prop, both holes and pose exactly unchanged; keep the same shot scale, head position and empty upper wall. Complete only the small lower trouser area previously hidden by the foreground slab, without introducing new furniture. No flat graphical blocks or borders.

videos.prompt: A near-still five-second living photograph. Locked-off camera, identical first and last composition. Preserve the reference adult woman's exact identity, face proportions, gaze, neutral closed-mouth expression, seated pose, clothing and lighting. Motion is confined to one delicate natural blink and imperceptibly small breathing. Everything below her shoulders stays perfectly still. No head turn, no smile, no hand or finger movement, no camera movement, no zoom or reframing. Keep the vermilion silicone double-loop sculpture rigid and motionless on her lap. Preserve exactly TWO holes, two padded round lobes, ONE broad connecting bridge, its outline, size, diagonal orientation, satin finish and hand contact point. No separate chain pieces, bending, squeezing, stretching or rotation. Preserve her other hand on the bench, white blouse, charcoal waistcoat, gray trousers, metal and wood bench, pale wall and shadows exactly. Minimal amplitude, an almost frozen photograph, gentle natural micro-motion only, settling into the exact reference frame for a calm continuous loop.

postprocess.notes: Film treatment adapted from approved Made photo grading, with temporal grain and blur scaled to the native video resolution.

videos.loop_note: Small natural pose changes remain between the first and last frames.
